tasks.description: Upgrade the Tool Supervisor to validate tool arguments, classify tool errors, retry failed calls when appropriate, and provide structured feedback to the planner. This improves reliability and prevents the agent from stalling or hallucinating when tools fail.
tasks.details: Introduce a ToolSupervisorV2 that wraps all tool calls with validation, structured error handling, and retry logic. Add a ToolError enum with categories (InvalidArgs, ExecutionError, NotFound, RateLimit, Unknown). Add a ToolResult enum that includes success, retryable failure, and fatal failure. Integrate this into the runtime loop so PlannerOutput::ToolCall receives normalized results.
